prompt: A realistic 1920s photograph on grainy colour film: real people with real skin, pores and stubble. Over the scene lies the fine engraved line work of a banknote: hair-thin curving parallel lines and rosettes in money-green and copper ink, wrapping round every contour like a contour map. Camera low at the foot of a plank. In a vast brick vault, gangsters in shirtsleeves with tommy guns slung on their backs wheel barrows of rubber-banded stacks up the plank onto a mountain of money; a fat one with a scar through his top lip pushes the nearest barrow, sweating. Light: hanging brass lamps, warm on the money; the vault's far end in deep green shadow. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
